21	import java.util.Collection;
22	import java.util.OptionalInt;
23	
24	/**
25	 * Derives an owner's {@code membershipLevel} from their scoring fields and applies the
26	 * household level ceiling.
27	 */
28	public final class OwnerMembership {
29	
30	    private OwnerMembership() {
31	    }
32	
33	    /**
34	     * Return the owner's natural (uncapped) membership level, derived purely from their own scoring
35	     * fields via {@link MembershipPointsFormatter} and {@link MembershipLevelFormatter}.
36	     *
37	     * @param owner the owner to score
38	     * @return the membership level, between 1 and 4
39	     */
40	    public static int naturalLevel(Owner owner) {
41	        int points = MembershipPointsFormatter.format(owner.getNamesakeCount(), owner.getEmail(),
42	            owner.getHouseholdSize(), owner.getRegistrationDate());
43	        return MembershipLevelFormatter.format(points);
44	    }
45	
46	    /**
47	     * Return the owner's effective membership level as reported to clients: the capped value stored
48	     * at creation time when present, otherwise the {@link #naturalLevel(Owner) natural level}.
49	     *
50	     * @param owner the owner to score
51	     * @return the membership level, between 1 and 4
52	     */
53	    public static int level(Owner owner) {
54	        return owner.getMembershipLevel() != null ? owner.getMembershipLevel() : naturalLevel(owner);
55	    }
56	
57	    /**
58	     * Return the owner's membership level capped by their household: it may not exceed one above the
59	     * current maximum level among the given existing household members. With no existing member no
60	     * cap applies and the {@link #naturalLevel(Owner) natural level} is returned.
61	     *
62	     * @param owner            the owner being created
63	     * @param householdMembers the existing members of the owner's household (excluding the owner)
64	     * @return the capped membership level, between 1 and 4
65	     */
66	    public static int cappedLevel(Owner owner, Collection<Owner> householdMembers) {
67	        int natural = naturalLevel(owner);
68	        OptionalInt maxMemberLevel = householdMembers.stream()
69	            .mapToInt(OwnerMembership::level)
70	            .max();
71	        return maxMemberLevel.isPresent() ? Math.min(natural, maxMemberLevel.getAsInt() + 1) : natural;
72	    }
73	}

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.ValidPostcodeForCity @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.ValidAddressForm"
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional courtesy title, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. When supplied it is
            prefixed to the last name to form the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          pattern: "^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$"
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when the
            structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred and this flat value is ignored.
            On responses this is the composed, normalized address: the normalized 'addressLine1'
            with the normalized 'addressLine2' appended after a single space when present, or the
            normalized flat address otherwise.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            First line of the structured postal address (typically street number and name).
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            Optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, suite, etc.), appended to
            the composed address after 'addressLine1' when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneDigits"
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.Email"
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the
            owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not
            supplied. When supplied it must not be later than the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent"
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it is used to derive the owner's
            'ageBand' relative to their registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already has the same
            last name and postcode (i.e. they share a household), bypassing the household-duplicate
            block. The owner is created as a declared household member and is not flagged as a
            possible duplicate. Write-only request flag; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formed as '<title> <lastName>' when a title is on file,
                or just the last name when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for human reading as the calling code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted as '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence.
              type: string

## Summary

I implemented `ownerSegment` following the existing computed-field pattern, keeping each piece of logic in its natural home:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — Added the `ownerSegment` read-only property to the `Owner` schema so the generated `OwnerDto` carries the field, documented with the same `<TIER>_<AREA>` rules as the other derived fields.
